name: Johann Casper Doll

events.title: Baptism
events.place: Ulmet Lutheran parish, Kusel district (family of Erzweiler)
events.description: Register p.245: parents 'Christoffel Doll und Anna Sara zu Erzweiler' (village read with help of the 1704 marriage entry); child 'Johann Caspar ist getaufft worden d. 1 Febr. 1722'. Godparents include a Peter Schuch (?), Johann Caspar Simon and Anna Elisabetha, wife of Christian Drum of Ulmet.

bioAdditions: Round 4 read the image of the Ulmet Lutheran baptism register (1722, p.245) that FamilySearch attaches to his profile. Johann Caspar, child of Christoffel Doll and Anna Sara, was baptized on 1 Feb 1722 (S1). One godparent appears to be a Schuch, which fits his mother's maiden name, Schuch. Another is the wife of Christian Drum of Ulmet, and a Simon Drum sailed with the Dolls on the Samuel in 1739. The register therefore confirms the Ulmet baptism and his parents' names, and it outweighs the 2 Feb 1724 date on his gravestone. FamilySearch (M7ZN-ZBL) labels him 'Capt.' and attaches a Historical Society of Pennsylvania burial card for 'Capt Casper Doll or Dull'; that card belongs to the nephew, Capt. Casper Dull (1748-1829), as the existing bio already explains. The burial-card image downloaded as 0 bytes. The village in the 1722 entry is Erzweiler: the 1704 Ulmet marriage of his parents calls his father 'Hans Peter Dollen Sohn zu Erzweiler' (see H0080).

conflicts.assessment: The register supports the site's 1722 date; the 1724 gravestone date is later and wrong.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Baptism and parents now primary-sourced; upgrade to confirmed only once the link to daughter Anna Maria (b. 1751) is proven.
